name: truncate
summary: Shrink or extend a file to a specified size.
description: Adjusts file sizes without changing file ownership or permissions; extending creates sparse regions when supported.

options.description: Set or adjust the file size using SIZE notation.
Do not create files that do not already exist.

examples.title: Clear a log in place
examples.explanation: Empties the log while preserving its path and metadata.

examples.title: Limit a test file
examples.explanation: Sets the file length to one mebibyte.

examples.title: Extend a sparse file
examples.explanation: Creates a logically large file without writing every block immediately.

warnings: truncate resizes files in place; with -s 0 the entire content is discarded immediately and cannot be recovered from the file.
